text: The AirAsia brand's listed parent is AirAsia Group Berhad (formerly AirAsia X Berhad), listed on Bursa Malaysia: in January 2026 it completed the acquisition of AirAsia Berhad and AirAsia Aviation Group Limited from Capital A (the Proposed Acquisition was of 100% equity interest in both), consolidating all AirAsia-branded airlines under a single listed airline platform, and effective 2 July 2026 it completed its name change from AirAsia X Berhad to AirAsia Group Berhad. Co-founders Tan Sri Tony Fernandes and Datuk Kamarudin Meranun continue to be substantial shareholders via their direct and indirect interests in the company.
short: AirAsia is owned by AirAsia Group Berhad (listed in Malaysia); co-founders Fernandes and Meranun are substantial shareholders.

source.name: AirAsia Newsroom: AirAsia X completes acquisition of AirAsia Berhad and AirAsia Aviation Group Limited from Capital A
source.quote: successfully completed the acquisition of both AirAsia Berhad (“AAB”) and AirAsia Aviation Group Limited (AAAGL) from Capital A Berhad (“Capital A”)
source.note: AirAsia X Berhad statement, 18 January 2026. The same statement says: 'The completion of this transaction consolidates all AirAsia-branded airlines under a single airline platform (AirAsia Group)'.

additionalSources.name: AirAsia Newsroom: Tune Group Sdn. Bhd. ceases to be a substantial shareholder in AirAsia X Berhad in line with conditions set out in the circulars to shareholders in AirAsia's aviation business consolidation
additionalSources.quote: the co-founders, Tan Sri Tony Fernandes and Datuk Kamarudin Meranun will continue to be substantial shareholders via their direct and indirect interests in AirAsia X
additionalSources.note: The same AirAsia X Berhad statement describes 'the Proposed Acquisition by AirAsia X of 100% equity interest in AirAsia Aviation Group Limited and AirAsia Berhad'.

additionalSources.name: AirAsia Newsroom: AirAsia enters new era as AirAsia Group Berhad, advancing its vision to become the world’s first low-cost network carrier
additionalSources.quote: has successfully completed its name change from AirAsia X Berhad to AirAsia Group Berhad
additionalSources.note: The statement says the name change followed shareholder approval on 25 June 2026 and registration by the Companies Commission of Malaysia, effective 2 July 2026.

additionalSources.name: The Edge Malaysia: Tune Group ceases to be substantial shareholder in AirAsia X after selling nearly 15% stake
additionalSources.quote: The plan, first unveiled in April 2024, involves the acquisition of AirAsia Aviation Group Ltd and AirAsia Bhd for RM6.8 billion by AirAsia X.
additionalSources.note: The Edge also reports Tony Fernandes holds a 2.5% direct stake in AirAsia X and Kamarudin Meranun 8.7% (as at January 2026, before Capital A's distribution of its AirAsia X shares to its own shareholders).
